note: Out-of-band link verification. The build sandbox only has outbound access to github.com / npm / pypi, so it records every other website as `blocked` even when the site is healthy. Each entry here was checked from a general network on the date shown, and is merged into docs/link-verification.json by scripts/verify-reference-links.mjs. The original sandbox probe result is preserved under `sandboxProbe` so the record never overstates what the sandbox itself could see.
method: page-fetch | host-probe (robots.txt returns the host's own text with HTTP 200, which proves TLS + DNS + origin are live)
